answer: The bridge is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the willow. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the island of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, split across independent auditors, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
